entries.topic: Germany's classrooms on Judaism, Israel and the conflict

claims.text: KMK, Central Council of Jews and Verband Bildungsmedien joint declaration on Judaism in educational media, adopted 13 Dec 2024, twelve points incl. a section on the State of Israel.
German-Israeli Textbook Commission set up 2011 by both governments; findings presented June 2015 ('Images of others').
14 Oct 2023: Berlin education senator's letter let schools ban keffiyehs, 'Free Palestine' stickers and maps in Palestinian colours; SPD spokespeople called a blanket ban constitutionally doubtful.
Oct 2023: Hessen support package; minister Lorz quote; NRW, Thuringia, MV guidance.

claims.text: Four streams: state-secular, state-religious, independent Haredi, Arab; Arab schools replace the Bible exam with Muslim, Christian or Druze heritage.
Globes 2012 projection: of ~370,000 new pupils 2001-2017, 43% Arab, 40% Haredi, 13% state religious, 4% state secular; state Jewish system share falling 52% to 41%.

Peled-Elhanan, Palestine in Israeli School Books (2012): dozens of books since the 1990s; images; maps; a textbook says flight after Deir Yassin 'solved a terrifying demographic problem'; Podeh rebuttal on 'considerable improvements'.

PRIME dual-narrative book 'Learning Each Other's Historical Narrative' banned by Israel's ministry (Zvi Zameret) after use at Sha'ar Hanegev school, and by the Palestinian ministry; Naveh: 'not legitimate in a democratic state to ban books'.

entries.topic: Palestinian classrooms: PA curriculum, UNRWA, East Jerusalem

claims.text: GAO Jan 2026: UNRWA educates 540,000+ children in ~700 schools in five fields using host curricula; pre-Oct 2023: 96 West Bank schools (45,000+) and 288 Gaza schools (298,000+); Gaza schooling stopped 7 Oct 2023; 2024-25 rapid review flagged 507 of 13,149 pages (3.85%), 349 of 435 issues on UN positions, 138 on the term 'Zionist', 95 on maps; US severed funding March 2025.

Aug 2023 Israeli government decision to raise share on Israeli curriculum in Jerusalem municipal schools from 24% to 45% by 2027-28; 125,000 pupils in East Jerusalem; Oct 2024 laws banning UNRWA operations.

Israeli-curriculum pupils in East Jerusalem: hundreds ~15 years ago, 10,000+ (2020), ~20,000 (2024), 27,000+ (2025, Ir Amim), 45,000+ / ~38% estimated 2026-27; funding of new schools conditional on Israeli curriculum; reported confiscation of Palestinian textbooks.
Ir Amim 2025: 1,461 classrooms missing or substandard (municipality figure); Decision 880 projects 1,204 classrooms, 20 added; new plan-funded schools must teach the Israeli curriculum.

entries.topic: Arab states' curricula on Israel (mostly IMPACT-se and INSS findings)

claims.text: IMPACT-se Jan 2022, 220 UAE textbooks 2016-21: tolerance, no incitement found; Israel absent from maps with one exception; Zionism negative; no Holocaust or regional Jewish history; Abraham Accords taught from grade 6 with Fatwa Council endorsement.
UAE confirmed Holocaust education to be added to curriculum, Jan 2023.
IMPACT-se May 2024: Saudi 2023-24 books dropped 'Zionist enemy', 'racist European movement' and warnings of expulsion; maps leave Palestine unnamed; 21 removals.
IMPACT-se Aug 2026, 136 Saudi books 2025-26: 'entirely free of antisemitic content' per CEO; 'Attempt to Create the Zionist Entity' renamed 'British Mandate in Palestine'.
INSS (Ofir Winter) 2016: Egypt's 2015-16 textbook has a full chapter on the peace treaty, Israel a partner in 'friendly' peace, Begin pictured with Sadat.

IMPACT-se May 2026, 125 Jordanian books: ninth-grade text presents treachery as a Jewish trait; new history book labels all land 'Palestine'; peace treaty framed as reluctant; Oct 7 framed with Israeli oppression first.

entries.topic: Britain, France, Pakistan, South Africa, Argentina

claims.text: DfE political impartiality guidance 17 Feb 2022 names the Israeli-Palestinian conflict; Zahawi: 'no subject is off-limits'.
Guidance: avoid materials on the conflict that lack balance; Board of Deputies welcomed; Cage challenging Williamson's earlier directive on organisations that reject Israel's right to exist.
Edexcel GCSE History new topics include Conflict in the Middle East (1945-95).
Hachette Education première textbook: chapter on 'L'ONU et la question palestinienne 1947-1948' using 'Nakba'; Crif, BNVCA objected; Hachette said contestable passages would be changed at printing.
Jan 2026: Hachette recalled three 'Objectif Bac Terminale' guides that called Oct 7 victims 'colons juifs'; Macron: 'intolérable'.
Mar 2023: CAIE removed 'Israelis and Palestinians since 1945' and a Gulf chapter from its history syllabus for 2024; Pakistan's curriculum council head cited national syllabuses.
South Africa's March 2026 draft history curriculum focuses FET on Africa; IRR says global 20th-century content 'is gone'.
Argentina's education minister Filmus said Holocaust education would be a required part of the curriculum (June 2006).
